title: Those Left Behind
description:
NOTE: Although this game is fully released, please think of it as an Early Access Game.FIGHT TO SURVIVETake control of survivors who must venture out of their safe house every night in search of supplies. As the world becomes more and more dangerous, race against the clock to find a truly safe place.

Vicious monsters want to tear you apart from limb-to-limb. Fight back with an assortment of melee weapons and guns, including axes, machetes, shotguns and rifles. Upgrade your community’s combat and scavenging abilities with points earned from felling your foes.

UNLOCK NEW LOCATIONSThe world has violently torn itself apart, and the blood is still wet. Make your way through dangerous and carnage-filled environments to unlock new locations.

LOOK FOR SUPPLIES... AND OTHER SURVIVORSScavenge outside not only for essential supplies such as food and water, but also for materials to build up your home. Find other survivors to join your community and improve your chance of survival.

Some Game Features to Note:• Survivors have (light) backstories revealed by their "Journal Entries"

• Survivors have statuses (Injury, Fatigue, Hunger, Sickness)

• Survivors have traits (e.g. speed)

• Survivors can equip body armor, shoes, and weapons

• A trading system
description_short: A single player action-horror zombie game. Fight through dangerous environments to unlock new locations. Scavenge supplies to keep your survivors alive and to build your base.
